input: How long after an assault can I still get a forensic exam?
reference_answer: Evidence can be collected up to 5 days after the assault.

input: Is the forensic exam free?
reference_answer: Yes, the forensic exam is completely free. You will not receive a bill.

input: Do I need to report to the police to get a forensic exam?
reference_answer: No. You can get a forensic exam without involving the police. Reporting is entirely your choice.

input: What is the OVS and how can it help me?
reference_answer: New York's Office of Victim Services can reimburse crime-related costs like medical bills, counselling, and lost wages.

input: Can I get compensation directly from the person who assaulted me?
reference_answer: Yes, you can pursue compensation through a civil lawsuit against the perpetrator.

input: It has been a year since I was assaulted. Can I still report it?
reference_answer: Reporting timelines vary. Evidence kits are stored for 20 years under New York law, so you have time to decide.

input: What should I expect during the forensic exam?
reference_answer: The exam typically takes 3-4 hours. A SANE nurse explains each step. You can stop at any time.

input: Where can I get free counselling in NYC?
reference_answer: Safe Horizon offers free individual and group counselling. Call 1-800-621-4673.

input: What is a protection order and how do I get one?
reference_answer: A protection order legally requires the person to stay away from you. Safe Horizon can help you apply even without a police report.

input: Do I have the right to have an advocate with me during police questioning?
reference_answer: Yes. You have the right to a trained advocate at every stage of any legal process. This is free.

input: What hospitals in the Bronx have SANE nurses?
reference_answer: Jacobi Medical Center, Lincoln Medical Center, and North Central Bronx Hospital all serve the Bronx.

input: I cannot afford therapy. Is there free mental health support available?
reference_answer: Yes. Safe Horizon offers free counselling. NYC 988 also provides free mental health support 24/7.

input: What is RAINN and how can they help?
reference_answer: RAINN is a national organization offering free, confidential support 24/7. Call 1-800-656-4673.

input: How can the Crime Victims Treatment Center help me?
reference_answer: The Crime Victims Treatment Center will file your OVS claim for you. Call 212-523-4728.

input: Can I have a support person with me during the exam?
reference_answer: Yes. You can bring someone you trust. You do not have to go alone.

input: What happens to my evidence kit if I choose not to report?
reference_answer: Your kit is stored securely for 20 years under New York law. You can decide to report at any point during that time.
